candidate_relations.reason: Pemphigus erythematosus matches photodistributed crusted plaques with dual DIF (intercellular plus basement-membrane IgG/C3) and ANA positivity (Senear–Usher).
Lupus erythematosus tumidus is a dermal lupus without acantholysis or intercellular IgG.
Rheumatoid arthritis is unrelated to this immunobullous/lupus-overlap dermatosis.
Pemphigus is the immunobullous family but omits the erythematosus (PF-plus-lupus) subtype.
SCLE is a cutaneous lupus subtype without the intercellular pemphigus DIF pattern.
Dermatomyositis is an interface myopathy dermatosis, not acantholytic pemphigus with dual DIF.
DIF is in the upper epidermis (PF/PE pattern), not the full-thickness PV pattern, so vulgaris is the wrong pemphigus subtype.
Ro/La antibodies are negative; Sjögren syndrome is not the blistering diagnosis.
ANA, lymphopenia, and anemia show lupus overlap features of Senear–Usher but SLE is not the requested pemphigus erythematosus diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Lupus serologies as the overlap component, not the PE object

candidate_relations.reason: Discoid lupus is scarring cutaneous lupus without intercellular pemphigus antibodies.
Cutaneous lupus erythematosus captures the lupus pole of Senear–Usher but omits the pemphigus/acantholytic component.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Cutaneous lupus as the lupus half of PE overlap

candidate_relations.reason: PE is often viewed as PF with lupus features; PF alone omits the basement-membrane DIF and lupus overlap.
Ro/La-negative disease with acantholysis is not cutaneous lupus plus Sjögren.
Psoriasis does not produce acantholysis or dual intercellular/BMZ immunofluorescence.
Polymorphic light eruption is a photodermatosis without pemphigus DIF.
Lupus erythematosus names the lupus overlap family but not pemphigus erythematosus as the final object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Lupus erythematosus parent of the overlap pole
